name: marketplace-helper
description: Multi-platform Chrome extension for user-reviewed marketplace listing autofill and photo transfer.

scripts.compile:content: tsc .generated/content.ts --outDir dist --target es2020 --module commonjs --lib es2020,dom --strict false --esModuleInterop true --skipLibCheck true
scripts.build:content: npm run generate:content && npm run compile:content
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate:content && tsc && vite build && npm run compile:content && npm run validate:build
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run build:web
